verdict.summary: Intuit is ~48% below its high on fears that AI agents take over tax and bookkeeping, and unlike Adobe this is showing up: TurboTax guidance was cut in May, management says price is now the top reason customers leave and accepts lower revenue per customer, and FY27 Consumer growth is guided to 4-6% (11% in FY26), total 9-10%. The damage is so far limited to consumer tax: QuickBooks and Global Business Solutions are guided +13-14% and Credit Karma +11-13%. The model's base case already uses the 9-10% guide and the bear case halves growth, so it was not changed; watch the 2027 tax season (units and revenue per customer) and QuickBooks customer growth. The price (~$341) is below the fair value (~$393).
